audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Leviticus / Vayiqra Day of Atonement text tradition, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for post-Nadab/Abihu entry boundaries, inner-sanctuary cleansing, two goats, Azazel/removal rite, incense cloud, blood/life rites, self-affliction, Sabbath-rest, and communal atonement.

verses.restored: YHWH spoke to Moses after death of two sons of Aaron, when they drew near before YHWH and died.

familiar.text: And the LORD spake unto Moses after the death of the two sons of Aaron, when they offered before the LORD, and died;

modern.text: Now the LORD spoke to Moses after the death of two of Aaron’s sons when they approached the presence of the LORD.

original.text: וַיְדַבֵּ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל מֹשֶׁ֔ה אַחֲרֵ֣י מ֔וֹת שְׁנֵ֖י בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֑ן בְּקָרְבָתָ֥ם לִפְנֵי יְהוָ֖ה וַיָּמֻֽתוּ

verses.restored: YHWH said to Moses, Speak to Aaron your brother, that he not come at any time into holy place inside veil, before cover that is upon ark, so he does not die; for in cloud I appear over cover.

familiar.text: And the LORD said unto Moses, Speak unto Aaron thy brother, that he come not at all times into the holy place within the vail before the mercy seat, which is upon the ark; that he die not: for I will appear in the cloud upon the mercy seat.

modern.text: And the LORD said to Moses: “Tell your brother Aaron not to enter freely into the Most Holy Place behind the veil in front of the mercy seat on the ark, or else he will die, because I appear in the cloud above the mercy seat.

original.text: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוָ֜ה אֶל מֹשֶׁ֗ה דַּבֵּר֮ אֶל אַהֲרֹ֣ן אָחִיךָ֒ וְאַל יָבֹ֤א בְכָל עֵת֙ אֶל הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת אֶל פְּנֵ֨י הַכַּפֹּ֜רֶת אֲשֶׁ֤ר עַל הָאָרֹן֙ וְלֹ֣א יָמ֔וּת כִּ֚י בֶּֽעָנָ֔ן אֵרָאֶ֖ה עַל הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת

verses.restored: With this Aaron shall come into holy place: with bull, son of herd, for sin/purification offering, and ram for burnt offering.

familiar.text: Thus shall Aaron come into the holy place: with a young bullock for a sin offering, and a ram for a burnt offering.

modern.text: This is how Aaron is to enter the Holy Place: with a young bull for a sin offering and a ram for a burnt offering.

original.text: בְּזֹ֛את יָבֹ֥א אַהֲרֹ֖ן אֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ בְּפַ֧ר בֶּן בָּקָ֛ר לְחַטָּ֖את וְאַ֥יִל לְעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: Holy linen tunic he shall put on, linen undergarments shall be on his flesh, linen sash he shall gird, and linen turban he shall wrap; holy garments they are. He shall wash his flesh in water and put them on.

familiar.text: He shall put on the holy linen coat, and he shall have the linen breeches upon his flesh, and shall be girded with a linen girdle, and with the linen mitre shall he be attired: these are holy garments; therefore shall he wash his flesh in water, and so put them on.

modern.text: He is to wear the sacred linen tunic, with linen undergarments. He must tie a linen sash around him and put on the linen turban. These are holy garments, and he must bathe himself with water before he wears them.

original.text: כְּתֹֽנֶת בַּ֨ד קֹ֜דֶשׁ יִלְבָּ֗שׁ וּמִֽכְנְסֵי בַד֮ יִהְי֣וּ עַל בְּשָׂרוֹ֒ וּבְאַבְנֵ֥ט בַּד֙ יַחְגֹּ֔ר וּבְמִצְנֶ֥פֶת בַּ֖ד יִצְנֹ֑ף בִּגְדֵי קֹ֣דֶשׁ הֵ֔ם וְרָחַ֥ץ בַּמַּ֛יִם אֶת בְּשָׂר֖וֹ וּלְבֵשָֽׁם

verses.restored: From congregation of children of Israel he shall take two male goats for sin/purification offering and one ram for burnt offering.

familiar.text: And he shall take of the congregation of the children of Israel two kids of the goats for a sin offering, and one ram for a burnt offering.

modern.text: And he shall take from the congregation of Israel two male goats for a sin offering and one ram for a burnt offering.

original.text: וּמֵאֵ֗ת עֲדַת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יִקַּ֛ח שְׁנֵֽי שְׂעִירֵ֥י עִזִּ֖ים לְחַטָּ֑את וְאַ֥יִל אֶחָ֖ד לְעֹלָֽה

verses.restored: Aaron shall bring near bull of sin/purification offering that is for himself, and make atonement/covering for himself and for his house.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall offer his bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and make an atonement for himself, and for his house.

modern.text: Aaron is to present the bull for his sin offering and make atonement for himself and his household.

original.text: וְהִקְרִ֧יב אַהֲרֹ֛ן אֶת פַּ֥ר הַחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר ל֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֥ד בֵּיתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He shall take two goats and stand them before YHWH at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And he shall take the two goats, and present them before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

modern.text: Then he shall take the two goats and present them before the LORD at the entrance to the Tent of Meeting.

original.text: וְלָקַ֖ח אֶת שְׁנֵ֣י הַשְּׂעִירִ֑ם וְהֶעֱמִ֤יד אֹתָם֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה פֶּ֖תַח אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵֽד

verses.restored: Aaron shall place lots upon two goats: one lot for YHWH and one lot for Azazel.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall cast lots upon the two goats; one lot for the LORD, and the other lot for the scapegoat.

modern.text: After Aaron casts lots for the two goats, one for the LORD and the other for the scapegoat,

original.text: וְנָתַ֧ן אַהֲרֹ֛ן עַל שְׁנֵ֥י הַשְּׂעִירִ֖ם גּוֹרָל֑וֹת גּוֹרָ֤ל אֶחָד֙ לַיהוָ֔ה וְגוֹרָ֥ל אֶחָ֖ד לַעֲזָאזֵֽל

verses.restored: Aaron shall bring near the goat upon which lot for YHWH came up, and make it sin/purification offering.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall bring the goat upon which the LORD’s lot fell, and offer him for a sin offering.

modern.text: he shall present the goat chosen by lot for the LORD and sacrifice it as a sin offering.

original.text: וְהִקְרִ֤יב אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶת הַשָּׂעִ֔יר אֲשֶׁ֨ר עָלָ֥ה עָלָ֛יו הַגּוֹרָ֖ל לַיהוָ֑ה וְעָשָׂ֖הוּ חַטָּֽאת

verses.restored: But goat upon which lot for Azazel came up shall be stood alive before YHWH, to make atonement/covering upon it, to send it away to Azazel, to wilderness.

familiar.text: But the goat, on which the lot fell to be the scapegoat, shall be presented alive before the LORD, to make an atonement with him, and to let him go for a scapegoat into the wilderness.

modern.text: But the goat chosen by lot as the scapegoat shall be presented alive before the LORD to make atonement by sending it into the wilderness as the scapegoat.

original.text: וְהַשָּׂעִ֗יר אֲשֶׁר֩ עָלָ֨ה עָלָ֤יו הַגּוֹרָל֙ לַעֲזָאזֵ֔ל יָֽעֳמַד חַ֛י לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְכַפֵּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו לְשַׁלַּ֥ח אֹת֛וֹ לַעֲזָאזֵ֖ל הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה

verses.restored: Aaron shall bring near bull of sin/purification offering that is for himself, and make atonement/covering for himself and for his house, and slaughter bull of sin/purification offering that is for himself.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall bring the bullock of the sin offering, which is for himself, and shall make an atonement for himself, and for his house, and shall kill the bullock of the sin offering which is for himself:

modern.text: When Aaron presents the bull for his sin offering and makes atonement for himself and his household, he is to slaughter the bull for his own sin offering.

original.text: וְהִקְרִ֨יב אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת פַּ֤ר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁר ל֔וֹ וְכִפֶּ֥ר בַּֽעֲד֖וֹ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֑וֹ וְשָׁחַ֛ט אֶת פַּ֥ר הַֽחַטָּ֖את אֲשֶׁר לֽוֹ

verses.restored: He shall take full firepan of coals of fire from upon altar before YHWH, and full double handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and bring inside veil.

familiar.text: And he shall take a censer full of burning coals of fire from off the altar before the LORD, and his hands full of sweet incense beaten small, and bring it within the vail:

modern.text: Then he must take a censer full of burning coals from the altar before the LORD, and two handfuls of finely ground fragrant incense, and take them inside the veil.

original.text: וְלָקַ֣ח מְלֹֽא הַ֠מַּחְתָּה גַּֽחֲלֵי אֵ֞שׁ מֵעַ֤ל הַמִּזְבֵּ֨חַ֙ מִלִּפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וּמְלֹ֣א חָפְנָ֔יו קְטֹ֥רֶת סַמִּ֖ים דַּקָּ֑ה וְהֵבִ֖יא מִבֵּ֥ית לַפָּרֹֽכֶת

verses.restored: He shall put incense on fire before YHWH, and cloud of incense shall cover cover that is upon testimony, so he does not die.

familiar.text: And he shall put the incense upon the fire before the LORD, that the cloud of the incense may cover the mercy seat that is upon the testimony, that he die not:

modern.text: He is to put the incense on the fire before the LORD, and the cloud of incense will cover the mercy seat above the Testimony, so that he will not die.

original.text: וְנָתַ֧ן אֶֽת הַקְּטֹ֛רֶת עַל הָאֵ֖שׁ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וְכִסָּ֣ה עֲנַ֣ן הַקְּטֹ֗רֶת אֶת הַכַּפֹּ֛רֶת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עַל הָעֵד֖וּת וְלֹ֥א יָמֽוּת

verses.restored: He shall take from blood/life of bull and sprinkle with his finger on face of cover eastward; before cover he shall sprinkle seven times from blood/life with his finger.

familiar.text: And he shall take of the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it with his finger upon the mercy seat eastward; and before the mercy seat shall he sprinkle of the blood with his finger seven times.

modern.text: And he is to take some of the bull’s blood and sprinkle it with his finger on the east side of the mercy seat; then he shall sprinkle some of it with his finger seven times before the mercy seat.

original.text: וְלָקַח֙ מִדַּ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֧ה בְאֶצְבָּע֛וֹ עַל פְּנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת קֵ֑דְמָה וְלִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת יַזֶּ֧ה שֶֽׁבַע פְּעָמִ֛ים מִן הַדָּ֖ם בְּאֶצְבָּעֽוֹ

verses.restored: He shall slaughter goat of sin/purification offering that is for people, bring its blood/life inside veil, and do with its blood/life as he did with blood/life of bull, sprinkling it upon cover and before cover.

familiar.text: Then shall he kill the goat of the sin offering, that is for the people, and bring his blood within the vail, and do with that blood as he did with the blood of the bullock, and sprinkle it upon the mercy seat, and before the mercy seat:

modern.text: Aaron shall then slaughter the goat for the sin offering for the people and bring its blood behind the veil, and with its blood he must do as he did with the bull’s blood: He is to sprinkle it against the mercy seat and in front of it.

original.text: וְשָׁחַ֞ט אֶת שְׂעִ֤יר הַֽחַטָּאת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לָעָ֔ם וְהֵבִיא֙ אֶת דָּמ֔וֹ אֶל מִבֵּ֖ית לַפָּרֹ֑כֶת וְעָשָׂ֣ה אֶת דָּמ֗וֹ כַּאֲשֶׁ֤ר עָשָׂה֙ לְדַ֣ם הַפָּ֔ר וְהִזָּ֥ה אֹת֛וֹ עַל הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת וְלִפְנֵ֥י הַכַּפֹּֽרֶת

verses.restored: He shall make atonement/covering for holy place from uncleannesses of children of Israel and from their transgressions, for all their sins/misalignments; so he shall do for tent of meeting dwelling with them in midst of their uncleannesses.

familiar.text: And he shall make an atonement for the holy place, because of the uncleanness of the children of Israel, and because of their transgressions in all their sins: and so shall he do for the tabernacle of the congregation, that remaineth among them in the midst of their uncleanness.

modern.text: So he shall make atonement for the Most Holy Place because of the impurities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins. He is to do the same for the Tent of Meeting which abides among them, because it is surrounded by their impurities.

original.text: וְכִפֶּ֣ר עַל הַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ מִטֻּמְאֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וּמִפִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְכֵ֤ן יַעֲשֶׂה֙ לְאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד הַשֹּׁכֵ֣ן אִתָּ֔ם בְּת֖וֹךְ טֻמְאֹתָֽם

verses.restored: No human shall be in tent of meeting when he comes to make atonement/covering in holy place until he comes out, and he has made atonement/covering for himself, for his house, and for all assembly of Israel.

familiar.text: And there shall be no man in the tabernacle of the congregation when he goeth in to make an atonement in the holy place, until he come out, and have made an atonement for himself, and for his household, and for all the congregation of Israel.

modern.text: No one may be in the Tent of Meeting from the time Aaron goes in to make atonement in the Most Holy Place until he leaves, after he has made atonement for himself, his household, and the whole assembly of Israel.

original.text: וְכָל אָדָ֞ם לֹא יִהְיֶ֣ה בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד בְּבֹא֛וֹ לְכַפֵּ֥ר בַּקֹּ֖דֶשׁ עַד צֵאת֑וֹ וְכִפֶּ֤ר בַּעֲדוֹ֙ וּבְעַ֣ד בֵּית֔וֹ וּבְעַ֖ד כָּל קְהַ֥ל יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: He shall go out to altar that is before YHWH and make atonement/covering upon it; take from blood/life of bull and from blood/life of goat, and put on horns of altar all around.

familiar.text: And he shall go out unto the altar that is before the LORD, and make an atonement for it; and shall take of the blood of the bullock, and of the blood of the goat, and put it upon the horns of the altar round about.

modern.text: Then he shall go out to the altar that is before the LORD and make atonement for it. He is to take some of the bull’s blood and some of the goat’s blood and put it on all the horns of the altar.

original.text: וְיָצָ֗א אֶל הַמִּזְבֵּ֛חַ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵֽי יְהוָ֖ה וְכִפֶּ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְלָקַ֞ח מִדַּ֤ם הַפָּר֙ וּמִדַּ֣ם הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְנָתַ֛ן עַל קַרְנ֥וֹת הַמִּזְבֵּ֖חַ סָבִֽיב

verses.restored: He shall sprinkle upon it from blood/life with his finger seven times, cleanse it and sanctify it from uncleannesses of children of Israel.

familiar.text: And he shall sprinkle of the blood upon it with his finger seven times, and cleanse it, and hallow it from the uncleanness of the children of Israel.

modern.text: He is to sprinkle some of the blood on it with his finger seven times to cleanse it and consecrate it from the uncleanness of the Israelites.

original.text: וְהִזָּ֨ה עָלָ֧יו מִן הַדָּ֛ם בְּאֶצְבָּע֖וֹ שֶׁ֣בַע פְּעָמִ֑ים וְטִהֲר֣וֹ וְקִדְּשׁ֔וֹ מִטֻּמְאֹ֖ת בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

verses.restored: When he has finished making atonement/covering for holy place, tent of meeting, and altar, he shall bring near living goat.

familiar.text: And when he hath made an end of reconciling the holy place, and the tabernacle of the congregation, and the altar, he shall bring the live goat:

modern.text: When Aaron has finished purifying the Most Holy Place, the Tent of Meeting, and the altar, he is to bring forward the live goat.

original.text: וְכִלָּה֙ מִכַּפֵּ֣ר אֶת הַקֹּ֔דֶשׁ וְאֶת אֹ֥הֶל מוֹעֵ֖ד וְאֶת הַמִּזְבֵּ֑חַ וְהִקְרִ֖יב אֶת הַשָּׂעִ֥יר הֶחָֽי

verses.restored: Aaron shall lay two hands on head of living goat and confess over it all iniquities of children of Israel, all their transgressions, for all their sins/misalignments, and put them on head of goat; he shall send it away by hand of appointed man into wilderness.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall lay both his hands upon the head of the live goat, and confess over him all the iniquities of the children of Israel, and all their transgressions in all their sins, putting them upon the head of the goat, and shall send him away by the hand of a fit man into the wilderness:

modern.text: Then he is to lay both hands on the head of the live goat and confess over it all the iniquities and rebellious acts of the Israelites in regard to all their sins. He is to put them on the goat’s head and send it away into the wilderness by the hand of a man appointed for the task.

original.text: וְסָמַ֨ךְ אַהֲרֹ֜ן אֶת שְׁתֵּ֣י ידו עַ֨ל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִיר֮ הַחַי֒ וְהִתְוַדָּ֣ה עָלָ֗יו אֶת כָּל עֲוֺנֹת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאֶת כָּל פִּשְׁעֵיהֶ֖ם לְכָל חַטֹּאתָ֑ם וְנָתַ֤ן אֹתָם֙ עַל רֹ֣אשׁ הַשָּׂעִ֔יר וְשִׁלַּ֛ח בְּיַד אִ֥ישׁ עִתִּ֖י הַמִּדְבָּֽרָה

verses.restored: The goat shall carry upon itself all their iniquities to cut-off land; he shall send goat away in wilderness.

familiar.text: And the goat shall bear upon him all their iniquities unto a land not inhabited: and he shall let go the goat in the wilderness.

modern.text: The goat will carry on itself all their iniquities into a solitary place, and the man will release it into the wilderness.

original.text: וְנָשָׂ֨א הַשָּׂעִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אֶת כָּל עֲוֺנֹתָ֖ם אֶל אֶ֣רֶץ גְּזֵרָ֑ה וְשִׁלַּ֥ח אֶת הַשָּׂעִ֖יר בַּמִּדְבָּֽר

verses.restored: Aaron shall come into tent of meeting, strip off linen garments he put on when he came into holy place, and leave them there.

familiar.text: And Aaron shall come into the tabernacle of the congregation, and shall put off the linen garments, which he put on when he went into the holy place, and shall leave them there:

modern.text: Then Aaron is to enter the Tent of Meeting, take off the linen garments he put on before entering the Most Holy Place, and leave them there.

original.text: וּבָ֤א אַהֲרֹן֙ אֶל אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד וּפָשַׁט֙ אֶת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַבָּ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֥ר לָבַ֖שׁ בְּבֹא֣וֹ אֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְהִנִּיחָ֖ם שָֽׁם

verses.restored: He shall wash flesh in water in holy place, put on his garments, come out and make his burnt offering and burnt offering of people, and make atonement/covering for himself and for people.

familiar.text: And he shall wash his flesh with water in the holy place, and put on his garments, and come forth, and offer his burnt offering, and the burnt offering of the people, and make an atonement for himself, and for the people.

modern.text: He is to bathe himself with water in a holy place and put on his own clothes. Then he must go out and sacrifice his burnt offering and the people’s burnt offering to make atonement for himself and for the people.

translation_notes: Leviticus 16 is explicitly framed after Nadab and Abihu; entry boundaries are about dangerous nearness to holy presence.
Kippur/atonement includes cleansing sanctuary from accumulated uncleannesses and transgressions, not only individual guilt relief.
Azazel is preserved without over-definition; removal goat carries iniquities away into wilderness/cut-off land.
Two-hand laying and confession over the living goat enact communal burden transfer/removal.
Self-affliction/humbling and no work apply to native and sojourner alike; communal cleansing includes resident outsider.
safety_note: Do not use Leviticus 16 for self-hatred or fear-based religion. The chapter creates a yearly rite for sanctuary cleansing, communal burden removal, rest, humility, and renewed cleanness before YHWH.
